title: 978. Number of Squareful Arrays

examples.explanation: Only [2,2,2] exists, and 2 + 2 = 4 is a perfect square.

hints: Build the permutation one slot at a time, only placing a value whose sum with the previous one is a perfect square.
Sort first and skip a repeated value unless its previous twin is already used, so identical permutations are counted once.
Adaptation: the input is a plain int_array and the answer is the count of distinct squareful orderings.
